meowhex.tooltip.mana_berry: +100 max mana per berry eaten (bonus cap +500)
meowhex.tooltip.mana_pie_slice: Applies Mana Regeneration (1% of max mana per second) for 10 seconds
meowhex.tooltip.self_torture_ring: +50% mana discount. The spared mana strikes back as overcast damage (5 mana = 1 HP)
advancement.meowhex:diadem_protect.desc: Be saved by having a crystal shatter in place of your mind.
meowhex.page.basic_extended_staves.0: As I learn more about this art, I find myself yearning for variety in my instruments just as I do in my work. I've since $(italic)cast/$ some time into the craftmanship of these curious sticks. The length allows for a miniscule addition in grid space, but not as I might get from a $(l:hexcasting:items/lens)$(item)Scrying Lens/$. As such, I find the choice between it and $(l:hexcasting:items/staff)$(item)its shorter sibling/$ can still be made of preference, rather than use.
meowhex.page.basic_extended_staves.craft: An extension $(italic)of an extension/$ of your mind$(br)$(italic)...$(br)We made it. We created it. We brought it forth from the night of the ages. We alone. Our hands. Our mind. Ours alone and only./$
Staves chiseled from the earth.$(italic)$(br)...$(br)No single one can possess greater wisdom than the many Scholars who are elected by all men for their wisdom.$(br2).../$
Staves born of that beneath the seas.$(italic)$(br)...$(br)Yet we can. We do. We have fought against saying it, but now it is said. We do not care.$(br2).../$
Staves mnemonic of the gateway to hellish lands.$(italic)$(br)...$(br)We forget all men, all laws and all things save our metals and our wires. So much is still to be learned!$(br2).../$
Staves constructed with otherworldly plant material.$(italic)$(br)...$(br)So long a road lies before us, and what care we if we must travel it alone!/$
meowhex.page.functional_staves_1.0: Of course, in my ingenuity, it would be narrow-minded to craft extensions of my staff only in the $(l:hexcasting:items/basic_extended_staves)physical sense$(/l). If I'm to cultivate a flexible and oh so utile art, my tools must so be as well. The first, a cleverly-thought but crudely built staff of amethyst. Peculiarly, the amethyst block will more readily crumble when directly used to weave the _media, providing itself to my _Hexes.
meowhex.page.functional_staves_1.craftin: For when you forget wood and you're already ~100 blocks deep in the geode
Unfortunately, the pointy end isn't a great weapon.$(br2) Now with an alternate recipe for sealing the long version!
meowhex.page.functional_staves_1.1: Furthermore, should I find myself enamored in its impure yet ordered, crude yet elegant, pungent yet aloft, glistening yet vacuous yet glistening yet-- $(br2)If I should like to keep it, I have found means of preventing its crumble, sealing it so that I may use it indefinitely. Though, of course, you cannot have your gleaming purple cake and eat it too, not more before the rapacious hands of Nature!
meowhex.page.functional_staves_1.2: The second, a hefty sphere fashioned to hold iota, not unlike a $(l:hexcasting:items/focus)Focus$(/l). While this on its own proved convenient, it bears its marvel in the form of bringing things once out of my range to the palm of my hand.$(br)Seeking after the unique energy given off by player entities (which enables them to be affected by me from any distance), I've made something that can magnify $(o)any/$ entity reference into the range of my _Hexes, so long as I hold the orb in either hand.
meowhex.page.functional_staves_1.craftin: Accepts any iota, but only amplifies signals from entities.$(br2)$(o)who up pondering they orb/$
meowhex.page.crossmod_staves_1.0: Whilst stumbling across the other powers that inhabit my world in addition to _Hexcasting, I've found myself entertaining the thought of using their arcane materials in staff construction. $(br2)To think, wielding a purple-gem-adorned staff carved from a magical wood that isn't purple! How blasphemous!
meowhex.page.crossmod_staves_1.1: In any case, these staves as well do not yet provide any additional benefit that I can discern. However, I maintain that they look quite a bit nicer when accompanying other tools made of the same materials in my arsenal. If I study other diverse tools and decide to use them myself, I'd do well to have a staff that feels at home next to them in my bag.
Mana? I hardly-- wait, what was I $(o)supposed/$ to reference?
meowhex.page.extended_fanciful_staves.1: Just as well, these glorious new tools must reflect the radiance that I have gained in their form. Just as my perception has risen to see a new horizon, it is only right that the dazzling end of my staff see the same. It is only right that it follows in the $(o)length/$ of my wit, my stature, my influence, $(o)my power/$. It is only right.
meowhex.page.base_diadem.0: Amid the admiration of such a glimmering stone, I'd begun wondering how it could fancy as part of some tasteful adornment. Naturally, my first construction would take the shape of a--$(br2)I was met with... a feeling. A sensation. The resonation of the crystal against my temples... I began to hear the quiet hum of the world surround me, like a tuning fork struck with its mallet. It's almost soothing.
meowhex.page.base_diadem.crafting.desc: The vibrations, they prod at the edges of my thoughts before slipping away. I feel as a cauldron filling with water under the rain, the excess trickling over the brim and lost. There must be $(#54398a)something more/$ to this...
meowhex.page.base_diadem.1: It... saved me. The _Hex tore through my... my bag, and if I had not... worn this--if I had placed it atop my head not before Nature surged to exact its payment--
meowhex.page.lokis_gambit.1: A trick worthy of the god of mischief himself. $(br2)Two entities — $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)s$(/l) — stand within my $(l:hexcasting:casting/influences)$(i)ambit$(/l), and with a flick of my staff their places are exchanged. Cost: 5 Amethyst Dust.
meowhex.page.lokis_gambit.2: Both targets must be in range, share the same dimension where teleportation is allowed, and not bear the $(#c00)cannot_teleport$(#222) tag. Passengers with the tag also block the spell. Cross-dimensional swaps are forbidden. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawqa$(/action) (EAST).$(br2)$(o)As Loki swaps his guise, so shall they swap their ground./$
meowhex.page.ovids_distillation.1: As Ovid wrote of forms transmuted, so I transmute matter itself. $(br2)Two $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) item entities — $(i)A/$ atop the stack (to be transformed) and $(i)B/$ beneath (the sacrifice) — must lie within my ambit with $(o)equal counts/$. Cost: 20 Amethyst Dust.$(br2)$(o)Also supports Create Depots:$(/o) two $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)s$(/l) pointing at $(o)create:depot$(/o) blocks — item $(i)A/$ in depot is transformed into result, item $(i)B/$ in the other depot is consumed. Mixed $(entity)+$(vector) also works with $(i)A/$ as target.
meowhex.page.ovids_distillation.2: If $(i)A/$ and $(i)B/$ match a registered recipe $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(workbench-like)$(/l) $(o)like a furnace/$, $(i)A/$ becomes the recipe's result (scaled by input count) at $(i)A/$'s position (or in depot $(i)A/$), while $(i)B/$ is consumed. Depot overflow spawns as item entities. Unequal counts mishap with $(#c00)"Неравное количество"$(). No recipe → mishap. Pattern: $(action)edqwqa$(/action) (EAST). Recipes: $(code)Hexcasting.registerOvidRecipe("minecraft:iron_ingot", "minecraft:coal", Item.of("minecraft:diamond",1))$
meowhex.page.daphnes_purification.1: As Daphne turned to laurel to escape, so I turn one green shoot into another. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) pointing at a placed $(o)sapling/$ or $(o)flower/$ within my ambit, I transmute it into a random other of its kind. Cost: 20 Amethyst Dust.
meowhex.page.daphnes_purification.2: Saplings become random other saplings; flowers become random other flowers. $(#c00)Wither Rose$(#222) is excluded as source and target — it will not be chosen and cannot be transmuted. Non-sapling/non-flower blocks mishap. Pattern: $(action)qaqwede$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.tartarus_inferno.1: The flames of Tartarus rise! $(br2)With a single $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) on a $(o)create:depot$(/o) or an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) item entity in my ambit, I smelt the item via its furnace recipe. Cost: 2.5 Amethyst Dust per item.
meowhex.page.tartarus_inferno.2: If the item has no furnace (smelting) recipe → mishap $(#c00)"Нельзя переплавить"$(). Result is scaled by input count; depot overflow spawns as item entities. Works with both depots and loose items. Pattern: $(action)qwaeqaw$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.hermes_deception.1: By Hermes' trickery, I weave a hollow twin. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) (LivingEntity/Mob), a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) position and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) look in my ambit, I create a deception at that position copying model/texture/size/hitbox/glow/equipment/pose/name — without AI, mechanics or intellect, only appearance. Cost: 100 Amethyst Dust (darker by 10%).
meowhex.page.hermes_deception.2: The deception has NoAI, gravity+physics, no fall damage, hitbox as original, pushable but not pushing, 1 HP (can be killed by attack), lives until killed/recalled/out of mana with upkeep 20 mana/s per clone (drained continuously) from caster. Max 5 per caster — 6th gives mishap. Can copy deception. Only LivingEntity/Mob. Gaze vector sets look. New type $(code)meowhex:deception$(). Pattern: $(action)wawqwqwqwaede$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.hermes_recall.1: By Hermes' recall, I dismiss my illusions. $(br2)With no stack, I banish all $(o)deceptions$(/o) bound to me (up to 5). Cost: 0.
meowhex.page.hermes_recall.2: All active deceptions for the caster are discarded. Pattern: $(action)ewqqweqqwe$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.hermes_whisper.1: Whisper of Hermes — a pattern or list and a deception. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(pattern/list)$(/l) and an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) (only deception) in ambit, the deception casts that pattern/list as if it were the caster. Cost: 20 dust for whisper + 10 per iota cast by deception (5 iotas → 70).
meowhex.page.hermes_whisper.2: Media is taken from whisper caster; if not enough, caster takes damage, deception is recalled and inner cast is cancelled. Deception casts from its own eye position with its look, ambit from deception, free media (already paid). Can chain until media/limit. Only deceptions. Pattern: $(action)wawqwqwqwaedeqqqqqwqqqqqeqqwqqqaqqwqqqqqwq$(/action) (EAST) 42.
meowhex.page.wings_of_irida.1: "Wings of Irida" — transfers one whole stack from one Create Depot to another.$(br2)The stack consumes two vectors: the top one is the *source* depot (A), the one below it is the *destination* depot (B).
meowhex.page.wings_of_irida.2: The source depot must contain the item to transfer. The destination depot must be completely empty (a depot only fits one stack), and both ends must actually be depots. Pattern: $(action)aawaqde$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.apollos_arrow.1: Apollo's shaft flies true! $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) or $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) source, a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) target and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) power 1–5 in my ambit, I loose an arrow from source towards target. Power sets speed 10% stronger than bow (1→0.66, 5→3.3). Cost: 5 + 10*power dust (15–55).
meowhex.page.apollos_arrow.2: If source is entity, arrow belongs to it and spawns at its eyes; if vector, belongs to caster at that pos. Target vector is world pos to aim. Arrow damage scales with speed. Leaves HEX tracer 1 per 3 ticks, not dense. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawqaqwawq$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.heras_wrath.1: By Hera's wrath, the tongue of magic is bound. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) target player (self allowed) and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) of seconds in my ambit, I silence their casting for that long.
meowhex.page.heras_wrath.2: The target must be a player. Seconds are silently clamped to 1–5 (above 5 → 5, below 1 mishaps). Cost: $(o)1000 mana per second/$ (so 1000–5000 mana for 1–5 seconds). Effect is the same $(#a9a)Silence/$$(#222) used elsewhere — the target cannot weave patterns or use any magic item until it fades. Pattern: $(action)qqqqqwqqqqqwqqqqwqqqqqeqqqqdqqqeqqqdqqqdqqqqaqqqqdqqqdq$(/action) (NORTH_EAST) 55.
meowhex.page.gerd_substitution.1: By Gerd's substitution I turn a gift into a bane. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) — a living target in my ambit — I strip one random beneficial effect from it and lay a random vanilla ailment in its place. Cost: 30 Amethyst Dust.
meowhex.page.gerd_substitution.2: The ailment inherits the duration and amplifier of the stripped buff (amplifier softly clamped to V, infinite duration to a minute). Instant effects take no part in the swap. No beneficial effects — mishap. A target immune to the drawn lot (e.g. undead to poison) draws again. Pattern: $(action)qaqwada$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.utgard_seal.1: By the Seal of Utgard I postpone the reckoning. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(pattern/list)$(/l) on the stack — only while wearing the $(o)ring of self-torture/$ — I cast it as $(l:hexcasting:patterns/meta)$(Hermes' Gambit)/$: Charon ends the seal, not the whole hex. Free.
meowhex.page.utgard_seal.2: The inner cast drinks $(o)10% more mana/$, but the ring's overcast does not strike at once: the whole debt is dealt as one blow after $(o)5 seconds/$. Dead or offline when it lands — the debt burns. A removed ring does not cancel it. Pattern: $(action)deaqqd$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.jormungand_laughter.1: With Jormungand's laughter I ground flying death. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) as the center and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) radius of 1–5 in my ambit, I quench the speed of all arrows around the target at once: they lose their drive and fall to the ground. Cost: 5 Amethyst Dust per block of radius.
meowhex.page.jormungand_laughter.2: Quenched are vanilla arrows, tridents and Apollo's arrows; sniper rounds heed no laughter. Radius above 5 is softly clamped to 5, below 1 mishaps. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawdw$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.ping_pong_gambit.1: With the Ping-Pong Gambit I turn foreign magic back on its master. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) — a living target — and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) of seconds 1–5 in my ambit, I mark it with Ping-Pong. Cost: 500 mana per second.
meowhex.page.ping_pong_gambit.2: While the mark holds, any effect laid on the target by the $(o)caster's hexes/$ is stripped off and hung on the caster as-is. Potions, beacons and arrows outside a cast do not bounce. Milk ends the mark early. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawqw$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.true_name.1: The True Name — the highest of all knowledge. $(br2)With no stack, I speak the pattern that opens a god's true name to me, and drink it in with my whole mind. Free.
meowhex.page.true_name.2: Who knows the name commands its bearer. Speak — and listen.$(br2)Pattern: $(action)qdqqqqd$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.chronos_delay.1: With Chronos' delay I postpone execution. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) of ticks and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(pattern/list)$(/l) on the stack, I schedule it N ticks out — like $(l:hexcasting:patterns/meta)$(Hermes' Gambit)/$, sharing stack and Charon boundaries. Cost: 1 dust per second of delay.
meowhex.page.chronos_delay.2: Ticks: fractions floored, above 100 clamped to 100, below 1 mishaps. The inner pays as usual when it fires. Offline, dead or relogged — the wait burns. Pattern: $(action)qwqqqwq$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.announcement.1: Announcement — the top iota from the stack is written into my chat input line. $(br2)A $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(pattern)$(/l) becomes a $(action)<dir,sig>$(/action) marker that will render as an actual glyph when sent; any other iota becomes its usual text. Free. Pattern: $(action)wqeqeq$(/action) (EAST) 6.
meowhex.page.comprehension.1: Comprehension — I reach into the chatter and grasp the last $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)patterns$(/l) players wrote in chat ($(action)<dir,sig>$(/action) markers) and lay them on my stack as a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/lists)$(list)$(/l). $(br2)Only what players actually typed counts; a message without patterns does not clear the previous set. Cost: 100 mana per pattern in the set. If nobody has written a pattern yet — mishap. Pattern: $(action)qeqeqw$(/action) (EAST) 6 — the mirror of Announcement.
meowhex.page.rune_visage.1: Rune Visage — I hang my data upon a sheet of light above an amethyst sconce. $(br2)Bottom to top of the stack: a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) — must point inside the sconce block, else mishap; a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(number)$(/l) — size (scale 0.5–5); any $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)iota$(/l) — what to show. The $(o)minecraft:text_display/$ sheet rises above the sconce. $(br2)If a sheet already floats within 0.5 blocks of the anchor, it is rewritten, else a new one appears. Break the sconce — the sheet disperses. Lists lie without commas or brackets — space-separated, nested alike. Colors are the usual, by iota type. Cost: 20 mana. Pattern: $(action)ewqeewqe$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.book.necronomicon.landing: Necronomicon — runes of darkness. Summoning and binding entities that fight for the caster.
meowhex.book.morpheus_grimoire.landing: Grimoire of Morpheus. Pages coming soon.
meowhex.book.loki_foliant.landing: Foliant of Loki — runes of trickery, exchange and transmutation. Wings of Irida, Hera's Wrath, Loki's Gambit, Ovid's Distillation, Apollo's Arrow, Tartarus' Inferno, Hermes' Deception and Whisper, Gerd's Substitution, Utgard Seal, Jormungand's Laughter, Ping-Pong Gambit, True Name.
item.meowhex.pattern_reader.tooltip: Click a pattern in chat history to copy it into your staff cast. Requires a staff in hand. Cost: 100 mana + 200 per iota.
meowhex.message.pattern_reader_missing: The Lens of Comprehension must be worn to copy patterns from chat
meowhex.message.need_staff: A staff must be held in hand to copy a pattern into the cast
meowhex.tooltip.sniper_scope: Worn on the head. Unlocks the Deadeye pattern — a wall-piercing round that strips 40% of the target's max health.
meowhex.message.need_sniper_scope: You must be wearing the Sniper's Scope to cast Deadeye
meowhex.message.deadeye_cooldown: Sniper's Scope is reloading — %s second(s) left
meowhex.page.deadeye.1: Deadeye — a sniper's round.$(br2)From a single $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) within $(thing)200 blocks/$ in the same dimension, I loose a $(o)homing shot/$ that passes straight through walls, terrain and armour alike, tearing away $(#c00)40% of the target's maximum health/$ as $(media)magic damage/$ on impact.$(br2)Cost: 400 mana (about 40 $(l:hexcasting:items/amethyst)$(item)amethyst dust/$).
meowhex.page.deadeye.2: Pulling this trigger requires the $(item)Sniper's Scope/$ worn on the head — Nature will not heed an unaided eye. The target must be a $(o)living/$ entity; the round ignores blocks, so only distance, death or another dimension can save it. It cannot be intercepted.$(br2)After each shot the scope must $(o)reload for 5 minutes/$ — you cannot fire again until it is ready.
meowhex.page.hades_summon.1: Hades' Summon — a zombie from darkness. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) position, a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) look and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(boolean)$(/l) (small zombie if true) in range, I summon a zombie fighting for me. In desert it becomes a $(o)husk/$.
meowhex.page.hades_summon.2: Cost: 100 dust. Upkeep: 20 mana/sec from caster (same as deceptions). Max 5 per caster — 6th gives mishap. The zombie attacks hostile mobs and the target the caster is attacking. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawde$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.hades_recall.1: By Hades' recall, I release my host. $(br2)With no stack, all my $(o)Hades zombies/$ and $(o)Styx shades/$ (up to 5 each) are banished. Cost: 0.
meowhex.page.hades_recall.2: Chains of Erebus bound to a banished zombie sever themselves. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawded$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.erebus_chain.1: Chain of Erebus — a tether between a victim and my summoned zombie. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) to bind and one of $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(my Hades zombies)$(/l) as the vessel, I shackle them together: the bound one keeps only $(thing)30%/$ of incoming damage, while $(thing)70% doubled/$ (140%) is dealt to the zombie instead. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawdeq$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.erebus_chain.2: Cost: 50 dust + upkeep 10 mana/sec per chain. The binding holds while the zombie lives and the $(o)Erebus' Binding/$ effect stays on the victim — milk severs it. A victim can be rebound to another zombie; one zombie may carry several chains.
meowhex.page.morrigan_gambit.1: Morrigan's Gambit — a battle-cry that turns all my servants onto a single foe: Hades zombies and Styx shades alike. $(br2)With an $(l:hexcasting:patterns/entities)$(entity)$(/l) as the mark, everything I command hounds it to the death — even if the mark is $(thing)me/$ myself. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawdeqw$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.morrigan_gambit.2: Cost: 30 dust. The order holds until the mark dies or a new gambit names another. The forced break their leash: they will strike the caster, their kin, anyone named.
meowhex.page.styx_shade.1: Shade of Styx — a vex from darkness. $(br2)With a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) position and a $(l:hexcasting:patterns/spells)$(vector)$(/l) look in range, I summon a vex fighting for me. It flies and passes through walls. Pattern: $(action)qaqwawdeqd$(/action) (EAST).
meowhex.page.styx_shade.2: Cost: 150 dust. Upkeep: 30 mana/sec from caster. Max 5 per caster — 6th gives mishap. The shade attacks hostile mobs and the target the caster is attacking.
meowhex.category.runes.desc: Magical patterns for summoning and controlling entities from darkness.
meowhex.category.loki_runes.desc: Runes of trickery, exchange and transmutation.
